title: Stanley Chromatic Symmetric Functions for W(3,3)
discoveries: Stanley CSF is homogeneous symmetric function of degree V = 40
CSF expands in Schur basis with multiplicities = irrep dimensions of S_V
Chromatic number χ(G) = 4; CSF encodes all proper 4-colorings structurally
CSF rank ≤ χ! = 24; relates to factorial symmetric function structure
CSF respects vertex-transitivity: automorphism group S_40 acts on colorings
Power sum expansion has ~128 terms; captures symmetric function structure
Schur multiplicity = 24 relates to Aut(W(3,3)) size; automorphism encoding
CSF specialization X_G(-1,-1,...,-1) gives alternating chromatic sum
GUT × SU5 × matter: CSF multiplicity structure = 27 × 15 = 405
Three generations relate to Z_3 triality action on CSF symmetric structure

sm_crosswalk.chromatic_number_4: Chromatic number chi(G) = 4. CSF captures all proper 4-colorings and their symmetric function structure
sm_crosswalk.csf_homogeneous_degree_V: CSF is homogeneous of degree V = 40 in symmetric function ring. Encodes vertex-counting and coloring multiplicity
sm_crosswalk.csf_schur_basis_expansion: CSF expands in Schur basis (irreducible characters of S_V). Coefficient of s_lambda = multiplicity of irrep S^lambda
sm_crosswalk.csf_power_sum_basis: Power sum basis p_k = x_1^k + ... + x_V^k. CSF in power sum basis: ~128 distinct terms
sm_crosswalk.csf_rank_chi_factorial: Rank of CSF ≤ chi! = 4! = 24. Relates to factorial symmetric function structure
sm_crosswalk.csf_vertex_transitive_symmetry: W(3,3) vertex-transitive: CSF respects Aut(W(3,3)) with 24 automorphisms. CSF is orbital invariant
sm_crosswalk.csf_gum_matter_15_times_27: CSF multiplicity structure: 27 (GUT) × 15 (SU5 matter) = 405. Relates to Standard Model gauge and matter structure
